StorageMixingLogicEnumeration.description: The StorageMixingLogicEnumeration describes standard ways of mixing material in a material  storage buffer.

Mixing.description: The material storage buffer containing a material accepts any other material.

NonMixingByProduct.description: The material storage buffer containing a material accepts other materials with the same MaterialDefinition.

NonMixingByBatch.description: The material storage buffer containing a material accepts other materials with the same MaterialLot.
